landingSectorsNote: Every call is classified into one or more of these. Pick one to search it.

landingSectors.offshore-wind: Fixed and floating wind at sea, including foundations and the cables inside the farm.
landingSectors.offshore-hydrogen: Hydrogen produced at sea or from offshore renewables, and floating solar.
landingSectors.green-ports: Shore power, cold ironing and electrification of the quay.
landingSectors.fleet-decarbonisation: Retrofits and new vessels that cut emissions, including electric ferries and alternative fuels.
landingSectors.subsea-cables: Subsea power cables, export cables and offshore substations.
